Subject: POC kickoff — coordinating hands-on deep dives across US / EU / APAC windows

Hi Sophie / Ian —

Excited to get the hands-on POC rolling. To make the technical deep dives useful for your infra and app teams, we want to schedule three 3-hour windows over the first two weeks: one that hits US mornings, one for EU overlap, and one late evening for APAC. That will let us run prompt review, routing checks, and a couple of short load-test rehearsals with progressively larger QPS.

Proposed blocks (all times are local to the region; we will send calendar invites with time-zone conversions):
- US morning block: 09:00–12:00 PDT — best for product + infra deep dive and prompt calibration.
- EU afternoon block: 14:00–17:00 BST — useful for ops + network routing validation.
- APAC evening block: 18:30–21:30 SGT — hands-on lab for on-site engineers and integration testing.

Ask: can you indicate which dates in the weeks of Jul 19 and Jul 26 work best for each block? Also flag any days where you prefer a "solo demo" (just 1-2 Redwood engineers + your PM) vs full working session. We attached a short runbook and a worksheet for load-test params so we can size the rehearsals.

Attachments: poc_runbook_v1.pdf, load-test-params.csv (see Drive link below).

If you prefer, we can provision a rotating schedule where a different Redwood pair owns each block (reduces handoffs). Internal folks on this thread — Marissa, Vivek, Priyom — I’ve penciled you for coverage; please call out conflicts.

Thanks,
Rohan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

- APAC evening on the week of Jul 19 is tough for our SGP team (clinic coverage). Can we move the APAC evening block to the week of Jul 26 (we can do Jul 27 or Jul 29 evenings).
- We’d like the first US morning block to be a shorter "solo demo" (90 minutes) to brief our product leadership before the full working session.
- For load tests: we prefer starting small (10–20 RPS) on day 1 and then ramping to 50–75 RPS for a targeted 30-minute window — the attached load-test worksheet helped.

Proposal:
- Jul 20 (Tue) 09:00–10:30 PDT — solo demo for product leadership
- Jul 21 (Wed) 09:00–12:00 PDT — full US working session (prompt review + routing checks)
- Jul 22 (Thu) 14:00–17:00 BST — EU session (network and auth flows)
- Jul 27 (Tue) 18:30–21:30 SGT — APAC evening working session (load rehearsals)

If that works, I’ll confirm internal attendees and send our calendar availability.

Cheers,
